steps.prompt: What happens to the main verb after did and didn't?
options: It goes back to its base form.
steps.answer: It goes back to its base form.
steps.why: did already carries the past, so the main verb is the base form: didn't go, Did you go?
steps.html:
I went to Guatemala.

Where did you go?

steps.title: Past Simple · negatives and questions
steps.html:
FormExample
Positiveverb + -ed / irregularI stayed six weeks.
Negativedidn't + base verbI didn't stay in a hotel.
Yes/no questionDid + person + base verbDid you stay in a hotel?
Wh- questionWh- + did + person + base verbHow long did you stay?
Short answersYes, I did. / No, I didn't.

did is the same for every person: I did, she did, they did.

The main verb never changes after did or didn't.

Short answers use did alone: Yes, I did. — not Yes, I went.

Learners often write Did you went? The correct form is Did you go?
